label: Google
note: One package, four icons, one fence. The surfaces share this package and therefore its cookie jar, which is what makes Gmail already signed in once Google Account is — Google's properties are one SSO family, not OAuth clients of each other. Given that, fencing them from each other would be theatre: a compromised Gmail page already holds Drive's cookies. So the fence here is the whole of google.com, and the separation that matters is the one between this jar and every other.
